svg.title: Phase-J versus GEMS conceptual difference
svg.desc: A paper-style side-by-side schematic showing that Phase-J performs test-time image repair while GEMS converts train-only evidence into a compact plain MeshSplatting representation.
svg.text: The key shift is from test-time image correction to train-time representation rewriting.
Previous idea: repair rendered images at test time
Deployment keeps an extra test-time repair module.
Ours: convert train-only evidence into the representation
Deployment discards teacher and adapter; only theta_GEMS remains.
Phase-J changes output pixels at test time.
GEMS changes mesh parameters before deployment.
